note.zh: 全稱《妙法蓮華經》，鳩摩羅什漢譯本流通最廣，七卷二十八品。
note.en: Full title Miaofa lianhua jing (Saddharma Puṇḍarīka Sūtra); Kumārajīva's Chinese translation in 7 fascicles and 28 chapters is the most widely circulated.

note.zh: 包含信受、憶持、讀誦、如說修行的意思。
note.en: Embraces receiving with faith, retaining in memory, reciting, and practising in accordance with the teaching.

en: the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss (Sukhāvatī)

note.zh: 阿彌陀佛所成的淨土。古譯亦作「安養」「安樂」。
note.en: The pure land created by Amitābha Buddha; also rendered in older texts as Anyang or Anle ("Peaceful Nurturing/Bliss").

note.zh: 西方極樂世界之教主；「彌陀」為其略稱。
note.en: The buddha of the Western Pure Land; "Mituó" is the shortened form.

note.zh: 《法華經．普賢菩薩勸發品》中發願護持誦經者的大士。
note.en: The great bodhisattva who vows in the Lotus Sutra's final chapter to protect those who recite the sutra.

note.zh: 《普門品》所說救苦救難的菩薩。
note.en: The bodhisattva of universal salvation described in the "Universal Gateway" chapter.

note.zh: 淨土宗核心行門；故事中「勤念彌陀」即勸人持名念佛。
note.en: The core Pure Land practice of holding the Buddha's name in mindfulness.

note.zh: 於定中見佛之觀想念佛法門，慧遠廬山蓮社所修。
note.en: A contemplative practice of visualising the Buddha within meditative absorption, as practised by Huiyuan's Lotus Society.

note.zh: 欲界第四天，彌勒菩薩現居之處。故事中天眾來迎兜率，與西方淨土之願不同，本站依原書分別標明。
note.en: The fourth heaven of the desire realm, where Maitreya Bodhisattva now dwells. Welcomings to Tuṣita in the sources are deliberately distinguished from aspirations to the Western Pure Land.

note.zh: 如異香、天樂、光明、面西而逝等。瑞相在原典中未必等同明言往生，本站分類時逐一註明。
note.en: Such as unusual fragrance, celestial music, light, or passing while facing west. The sources do not always equate these with asserted rebirth; each case is labelled.

note.zh: 東晉慧遠於廬山結社，共期往生西方，以白蓮為名。
note.en: The community founded by Huiyuan at Mount Lu in the Eastern Jin, vow-ing mutual rebirth in the West, named after the white lotus.

note.zh: 依《法華經》修觀所成之三昧，慧思、智顗皆有所證。
note.en: The meditative realisation arising from contemplation of the Lotus Sutra, attained in varying degrees by Huisi and Zhiyi.

en: purity of the six sense faculties

note.zh: 《法華經》所說功德；常不輕菩薩臨終聞法得六根清淨。
note.en: A benefit described in the Lotus Sutra; the Bodhisattva Never Disparaging attained it upon hearing the sutra at the end of his life.

note.zh: 古籍正文行間小注，常標示資料出處；本站以〔注：…〕保留。
note.en: Small notes between the lines of classical editions, often citing sources; preserved on this site as 〔note: …〕.
